search_parameters.q: an api for google search data

text_blocks.answer: There are several APIs to access Google search data, including the Custom Search JSON API (need API key and Programmable Search Engine ID) and various SERP APIs that scrape Google results (pricing and usage vary).

raw.markdown: There are several APIs to access Google search data, including the Custom Search JSON API (need API key and Programmable Search Engine ID) and various SERP APIs that scrape Google results (pricing and usage vary).

reference_links.title: Custom Search JSON API
reference_links.snippet: The Custom Search JSON API allows programmatic retrieval of web and image search results from a Programmable Search Engine. Results are returned in JSON format and the API follows the OpenSearch 1.1 Specification. To use the API, you need a configured Programmable Search Engine and an API key. The API offers 100 free queries per day, with additional queries available for a fee.

Other providers offer Google Search APIs for SERP data, including features like organic results, ads, related queries, and AI overviews, usually with JSON responses and paid plans.
